test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

I said to my father, “Don’t worry! I will complete all the work by tomorrow.”

options.text: I assured my father that I would have completed all the work by the following day
I assured my father that I will complete all the work by the following day.
I assured my father that I would complete all the work by the following day.
I told my father do not worry I would complete all the work by tomorrow.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in direct speech.
 
• The verb form "I will complete" needs to be transformed to "I would complete" for correct reported speech.
 
• The time reference "tomorrow" should be changed to "the following day."
 
• Therefore, the correct conversion to indirect speech is: "I assured my father that I would complete all the work by the following day."

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 3.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 uses "would have completed," which incorrectly refers to a conditional past event that did not happen.
 
• Option 2 does not change the future tense "will complete" to the conditional past tense form "would complete," which is required when converting from direct to indirect speech.
 
• Option 4 is not grammatically coherent and also violates the rules of reported speech.
